sources.snippet: waxal-lin-omniasr-llm-1b OmniASR LLM-1B v2, fine-tuned for Lingala as part of the WAXAL ASR solution. Released artifact: top-3 uniform FP64 parameter average. Decoded with beam 5, length_norm=True. Files ... Total weights: 9,118,680,523 bytes (9.12 GB). Role in the pipeline Member of the 4-way conservative word ROVER on the Lingala lane.

sources.title: Small llm model within 100M to 1B parameter : r/LocalLLaMA - Reddit
sources.snippet: Hello everyone, I'm currently working on a small project involving a language model (LLM) applied to my own documents. Presently, I'm using bge-base embedding, ChromaDB, and an OpenAI LLM. However, I'm looking to replace the OpenAI model with a smaller open-source LLM that can effectively utilize context from a vector database to generate accurate responses.
